Package com.hitorro.jsontypesystem.datamapper

Class MappingContext

java.lang.Object
com.hitorro.jsontypesystem.datamapper.MappingContext
public class MappingContext extends Object
The context for a single mapping operation. Contains three registers accessible from Groovy DSL scripts:
  • source — the input JVS document (read-only by convention)
  • target — the output JVS document being built
  • work — a scratch register for intermediate values
All three are JVS objects, so the DSL can use paths like "source.title.mls[0].text" uniformly. The context also holds the data generators and a document counter.
